about: RBI Payments Vision 2028, 'Shaping India's Payment Frontier' (27 March 2026; horizon 31 December 2028). Fifteen initiatives; most are to be explored or examined, the Cyber KRI framework (3.9) is to be developed and implemented. Initiative references and links to library controls only.

controls.title: Cyber key risk indicators with thresholds and trends
controls.description: A defined set of cyber KRIs with early-warning thresholds, tracked over time and reported (RBI is developing a framework for non-bank payment system operators).

controls.title: Customer switch on/off for every digital payment mode
controls.description: Customers can enable or disable transactions on each digital payment mode through issuer channels, as already for cards.

controls.title: Beneficiary-side fraud and mule-account detection (shared responsibility)
controls.description: Monitoring of incoming transactions and beneficiary accounts, since the beneficiary's bank may share liability for unauthorised digital transactions.

controls.title: Governed AI access to payments data
controls.description: AI querying of payments data runs through a control point with data-residency rules, masking of personal data, a query audit trail and per-caller limits.
